listings.name: Adelaide Showground Farmers' Market
listings.otherProducts: Fresh produce and food from stallholders; specific product lines not recorded
listings.hoursAsStated: Open every Sunday 8.30am - 12.30pm, free entry, no dogs.
listings.description: Weekly Sunday farmers market held at the Adelaide Showground.
listings.caveats: Product categories not itemised from the page opened; check the site's food and produce pages before tagging products. Official site opened via curl (WebFetch could not resolve it).

listings.name: Barossa Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Meats, breads, cheeses, oils, preserves, pastries and prepared food from Barossa and regional SA stallholders
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Saturday morning 7.30am to 11.30am, in the Vintners Shed behind Vintners Restaurant.
listings.description: Saturday morning market of Barossa and regional South Australian growers and makers in a historic winery shed.
listings.caveats: Phone is the mobile number the market's own site lists under 'Get in touch'.

listings.name: Willunga Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Producer stalls; product lines not recorded from the page opened
listings.description: Weekly Saturday farmers market in the McLaren Vale and Fleurieu region.
listings.caveats: Street number not given; the venue is the high school grounds on Main Road. Search snippets mention holiday closures (Christmas Day, New Year's Day) not confirmed on the page.

listings.name: Adelaide Hills Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Fresh Adelaide Hills produce and hot food; specific lines not recorded
listings.description: Weekly Saturday farmers market under elm trees in Mount Barker; dogs are welcome per the site.
listings.caveats: Postcode 5251 is the standard Mount Barker postcode but was not printed on the page opened. A search snippet mentioned a winter gym venue; not confirmed.

listings.name: Beerenberg Farm
listings.otherProducts: Own jams, chutneys, relishes and sauces; strawberry picking (November to April per Visit Adelaide Hills); farm cafe

hours.note: Closed Christmas Day. Strawberry patch hours/availability vary and the site says to check on the day.

listings.hoursAsStated: Farm shop open 9am to 5pm every day except Christmas Day.
listings.description: Family farm at the eastern end of Hahndorf with a farm shop and a pick-your-own strawberry patch.
listings.caveats: No street number published on the pages opened. Most farm-shop stock is processed products, not raw farm produce; strawberries are seasonal pick-your-own.

listings.name: Margaret River Farmers Market
listings.address: Margaret River Education Campus, Lot 272 Bussell Highway
listings.otherProducts: Local producer stalls; specific lines not recorded
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Saturday all year round, 7:30am - 11:30am. No dogs.
listings.description: Year-round Saturday farmers market at the Margaret River Education Campus.
listings.caveats: Several third-party sites say 8am-12pm or a seasonal split; the market's own site says 7:30-11:30 all year, which is used here. Postcode 6285 is the standard Margaret River postcode, not printed on the page. Site lists a coordinator mobile; omitted as a personal contact.

listings.name: Subi Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Meat, seafood, flowers, coffee and prepared food (site title lists these)
listings.description: Long-running not-for-profit Saturday farmers market held at Subiaco Primary School.
listings.caveats: Postcode 6008 not printed on the page (standard Subiaco postcode). Products inferred from the site's page title, not a stallholder list. Site contains old news items; hours are on the current header.

listings.name: Perth City Farm Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Artisan goods, ethical and sustainable products; Perth City Farm organic stall

hours.note: Summer hours Dec-Mar 7:30-11:30am; April-November 8am-12 noon (this entry uses the Apr-Nov hours, which apply now).

listings.description: Saturday farmers market in the courtyard of an urban community farm, focused on organic, biodynamic and spray-free WA produce.
listings.caveats: Organic/spray-free tags reflect the market's stated focus, not per-stall certification. The hours change on 1 December.

listings.name: Albany Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Bread, olive oil, fish, meat as available, preserves, macadamias, seedlings, coffee
listings.hoursAsStated: Fresh produce every Saturday 8am - 12pm, Collie Street Albany.
listings.description: Saturday growers' market in Albany's historic centre, running since 2002.
listings.caveats: No street number; postcode 6330 is the standard Albany postcode, not printed on page. Items listed depend on season.

listings.name: Freo Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Ready-to-eat food, fresh produce, clothing and artisan gifts; stated to be plastic-free
listings.description: Sunday farmers market at Bruce Lee Reserve, Beaconsfield, relocated there from Fremantle College in 2023.
listings.caveats: Source is a City of Fremantle media release (Dec 2025), not the market's own site (could not be opened). Postcode 6162 and street not on the release; an unverified listing gave 5 Caesar St. Older guides still show Fremantle College, which is outdated.

listings.name: The House of Honey & Sticky Spoon Cafe
listings.otherProducts: Meads and liqueurs, bee products, cafe

hours.note: Cafe closes 4.30pm; closed Good Friday, Christmas Day, Boxing Day; open most other public holidays (call to confirm).

listings.hoursAsStated: Open 10:00-17:00 daily per the Swan Valley listing.
listings.description: Swan Valley beekeeper's shop selling unpasteurised WA honeys, with a cafe and bee display.
listings.caveats: Source is the regional tourism site, not the business's own site. Business website not recorded.

listings.name: Baba & Dida's Marketplace
listings.otherProducts: Olive oil, jams, wine vinegar, garlic, bakery and coffee

hours.note: Closing time depends on produce available; closed Christmas Day, Boxing Day, New Year's Day.

listings.description: Family roadside produce market in the Swan Valley selling Valley-grown fruit, vegetables, eggs and honey.
listings.caveats: Regional tourism listing only; verify hours on the business's Facebook page. Source states the fruit is in season only.

listings.name: Keller's Farm
listings.otherProducts: Sourdough and Swiss baking, jams, quince paste, muesli; seasonal citrus, figs, potatoes, garlic and greens

hours.note: Open some public holidays (call/Facebook); closed Christmas Day, Boxing Day, New Year's Day.

listings.hoursAsStated: Street market open each weekend, 08:00-16:00 per the listing.
listings.description: Family roadside stall in the Swan Valley selling free-range eggs, baking and seasonal produce on weekends.
listings.caveats: Tourism listing only. Free range claim is the listing's wording.

listings.name: Windarra Honey
listings.otherProducts: Creamed honey, bee products, honey drinks

hours.note: Open some public holidays; call or check Facebook.

listings.description: Family beekeeping business in the Swan Valley with honey tastings and sales.
listings.caveats: Tourism listing only; business website not recorded.

listings.name: West Road Farm

hours.note: Stall may close early if produce sells out.

listings.hoursAsStated: Farm stall (back of an old tractor) open every weekend 08:00-13:00.
listings.description: Swan Valley farm selling seasonal fresh produce from a weekend farm stall.
listings.caveats: Listing says the farm grows using organic and biodynamic principles; no certification claimed, so no organic tag. 'veg' is inferred from 'fresh produce' wording; confirm. Listing is from the Swan Valley tourism site.

listings.name: Baudin's Macadamias
listings.otherProducts: Macadamia nuts, honesty-box farm gate stall

hours.note: Seasonal: nuts on sale from late May until stocks run out, approx. May-November; orchard tours by appointment.

listings.hoursAsStated: Farm gate stall, leave money in the box; approx. May to November.
listings.description: Swan Valley macadamia orchard selling nuts from an honesty-box stall in the cooler months.
listings.caveats: Season may already be ending (stocks run out before Christmas) - confirm before listing. No opening hours published.

listings.name: Bickley Valley Fresh

hours.note: Open Friday to Sunday; closed public holidays. Opening times of day not published on page opened.

listings.hoursAsStated: Open Friday to Sunday (closed on public holidays).
listings.description: Perth Hills orchard shop selling fresh seasonal fruit, vegetables, eggs and honey.
listings.caveats: Source is Experience Perth Hills tourism listing only; no times of day. Business website not confirmed (the 'website' field points to the tourism listing); postcode 6076 is not on the page (standard Bickley postcode). A search snippet suggested times but was not verified.
